meaning: Evidence sidecar for the main-side Lean package, following the Math- formal lane contract (docs/FORMAL_VERIFICATION.md; historical formal-ladder work item #95, retained in coordination.work_item as provenance rather than current pickup routing). `proved` here means proof text supplied and bound by hash; `kernel-checked` is reported only by the receipt of a trusted --run-lean execution at an exact commit. Alignment is a separate pending/accepted/stale dimension. Nothing in this file is a scientific register entry or changes any ACCEPT/AMEND disposition.

coordination.work_offer_addressed: Numerical formalizer, first step only: the exact arithmetic skeleton of the SIDE24 note. The coefficient definition and the proof-producing enclosure pipeline are NOT supplied.

targets.name: UniversalLaw.Side24.pairing_sum_six

targets.informal_anchor:
The coefficient sum for q=6 is
1+15+45+15=76
targets.does_not_claim: the derivative bound 76|x|^6 e^(-|x|^2/2) itself
